name: Jasper Fel
summary: At SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Jasper Fel keeps watch on visitors and warns them to mind their speech.

sections.title: Supplies for the Shadows
sections.body: Jasper Fel supplies the agents inside SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. His wares include simple daggers and empty vials for brewing and applying poisons. He serves Mathias Shaw's intelligence division and warns visitors to mind their speech. Here, careless words can put people in danger.

faq.q: Where can I find Jasper Fel?
faq.answer: Jasper Fel is inside SI:7 headquarters in eastern Old Town, Stormwind City.
Jasper Fel supplies simple daggers and empty vials in various grades for operatives.

faq.q: Is Jasper Fel related to Morbent Fel?
aliases: is jasper fel related to morbent
faq.answer: Jasper Fel and Morbent Fel share a surname, but Jasper keeps silent about his personal matters.

faq.q: Why does Jasper Fel warn people to speak quietly?
faq.answer: Jasper Fel warns visitors to mind their speech because he works inside SI:7, Stormwind's espionage headquarters, where loose talk is dangerous.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can find vials and spare blades from Jasper Fel for covert work in Stormwind.
As an Alliance member, you can rely on SI:7 headquarters to supply the agents who defend the kingdom from the shadows.
